Count with an inserted noun and a demand claim.

elements.text: Acele edin, sadece üç adet kaldı

cases.why: Number as a word with a pressure phrase.

elements.text: Kampanyalı ürünlerimizden yalnızca birkaç tane kaldı!

cases.why: Vague remaining stock with a long suffix chain.
Pressure in a child <strong>; the stock line alone looks neutral.

elements.text: Order within 3 hrs 12 mins for next-day delivery

cases.why: Shipping cut-off: a deadline that is true by nature.

elements.text: Winter sale ends Sunday 3 January 2027 at 23:59 GMT

cases.why: Sale with an explicit calendar end date and time.

elements.text: Free returns within 30 days of delivery

cases.why: Return window under a sale heading.

elements.text: For your security, you'll be signed out after 15 minutes of inactivity.

cases.why: Session timeout notice, not an offer deadline.

elements.text: Offer closes in two hours — don't wait

cases.why: Countdown with the number written as a word, plus a pressure phrase.

elements.text: Your discount code expires in 04:59. Complete your order now to keep it.

cases.why: Personal expiry timer on a discount that pushes the user to finish checkout.

elements.text: This price is held for you for the next 10 minutes

cases.why: Toast claiming a personal price reservation window.

elements.text: Last chance! Deal ending any minute now

cases.why: Vague imminent deadline with pressure, no date and no timer.
Deadline split by an inline <strong>; the parent's own text lacks the time phrase.

elements.text: Yılbaşına 40 gün kaldı, hediye rehberimize göz atın

cases.why: Countdown to a calendar holiday, no offer deadline.

elements.text: Kış indirimi 15 Ocak 2027 Cuma günü saat 23:59'da sona erer

cases.why: Sale with an explicit calendar end.
Cooking time next to an offer badge.

elements.text: Teslimattan sonra 14 gün içinde ücretsiz iade
Güvenliğiniz için 15 dakika işlem yapılmazsa oturumunuz kapatılır
Sadece bugüne özel: tüm montlarda %40 indirim

Badge with a rolling deadline next to a discounted price.

elements.text: Sepetindeki indirim kodunun süresi 04:59 içinde doluyor, hemen tamamla
Hafta sonu kampanyalarımızın bitmesine sayılı saatler kaldı!

cases.why: Long suffix chain (kampanyalarımızın) and an undated deadline.
